in_text_mentions: ar region (Figure 1(b)). The change of the density in the suprasellar region on CT suggested the pituitary apoplexy. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) taken 2 days after admission detected isointensity on T1WI and high intensity on T2WI in the suprasellar region (Figure 2). CT also showed a low density area in the territory of the right MCA, which indicated the cerebral infarction (Figure 1(c)). MR angiography (MRA) showed signal loss with poor visibility of distal right middle cerebral arteries (MCAs) (Figure 3). The conservative treatment for cerebral infarction improved her left hemiparesis.
